events.title: Transformer fleet strain scenario around concentrated data-center clusters
events.summary: Localized transformer stress near data-center clusters could force emergency procurement and temporary capacity measures. The balance between short-term fixes and long-lead replacements will shape reliability outcomes.

events.title: Permitting slowdowns creating transmission project slippage scenario
events.summary: Longer permitting cycles for transmission corridors may delay project commissioning, maintaining renewable curtailment and encouraging distributed alternatives.

events.title: Shifts in insulation and copper supply scenario affecting HV-equipment deliveries
events.summary: Material supply pressure could force equipment re-specifications with consequential testing and timeline impacts, affecting project schedules and asset performance assumptions.

events.title: Modular substation adoption scenario as response to long lead times
events.summary: Modular substations are emerging as a near-term mitigation for long equipment lead times, but they require standards and interconnection alignment to scale without creating new integration friction.

events.title: AI-driven rack density driving substation stress scenario
events.summary: AI compute density increases episodic stress on substations, prompting consideration of batteries, contractual changes, and targeted hardware upgrades to avoid reliability impacts.

events.title: Wind and solar curtailment scenario driving storage demand
events.summary: Renewable curtailment is encouraging storage co-location and hybrid projects, prompting operational and interconnection changes at impacted nodes.

events.title: Critical-mineral supply tightening scenario affecting transformer and battery timelines
events.summary: Sustained critical-mineral tightness could extend lead times for batteries and transformers and change procurement behaviors toward buffer inventories or alternative specifications.

events.title: Interconnection queue and capacity market tension scenario
events.summary: Interconnection and market design friction could prompt project deferrals, worsening near-term capacity shortfalls and prompting regulatory reform discussions.

events.title: Operational AI optimization uptake scenario with integration and cyber trade-offs
events.summary: AI can improve operational efficiency and asset management but requires governance, explainability, and cybersecurity frameworks to avoid introducing new system risks.

events.title: Workforce shortage and predictive maintenance adoption scenario at substations
events.summary: Skill shortages are prompting predictive maintenance adoption, which can reduce failures if paired with spare-parts strategies and training; gaps in either could limit benefits.
